title: Suggestions (Console) beta rollout checklist — platform engineering
linked_artifacts: Linear: ENG-2403 (baseline cost metrics + freshness SLOs)
GitHub: redwood#18723 (flag plumbing + allowlist admin tool)
content:
Purpose
- Operational checklist to enable the Console “Suggestions” view (beta) for a small tenant cohort.
- This is a read-only beta (no “Apply” workflows). Main risks: tenant isolation, misleading savings estimates, stale telemetry, and increased load on suggestions-service.

Owners / escalation
- Rollout driver (Platform): Ethan Park
- Release train / coordination: Connor O’Brien
- SRE readiness / incident triage: Rafael Mendes
- Console backend (BFF): Chloe Martin
- Telemetry baselines / freshness: Logan Wright
- Support readiness + FAQ: Dev Patel
- Product sign-off: Marissa Cole (Console), Aditya Rao (Optimize)
- Security/RBAC sign-off: Kaitlyn Nguyen / Marcus Lin

Definitions (used in checklist)
- “Tenant”: customer workspace (workspace_id)
- “Cohort”: allowlisted set of workspace_ids
- “Suggestions view”: Console UI + BFF calls to suggestions-service
- “suggestions-service”: backend service that returns list/detail + savings/risk payloads

Feature flags (prod + staging)
- console.suggestions_beta_ui (client-side; shows nav + page routes)
- console.suggestions_beta_bff (server/BFF-side; enables BFF endpoints)
- suggestions_service.read_api_enabled (service-side; gates /suggestions and /suggestions/{id})
- suggestions_beta_allowlist_enforced (server-side; hard block non-allowlisted tenants even if UI flag on)

Allowlist
- Source of truth: allowlist table/config (maintained by platform admin tool from redwood#18723)
- Key: workspace_id (NOT account_id), to avoid multi-workspace enterprise gotchas
- Required fields per allowlist entry:
  - workspace_id
  - enabled_environment (staging|prod)
  - enabled_at
  - enabled_by
  - notes (optional: AE/CSM owner, ticket link)

Pre-rollout prerequisites (must be green)
[ ] Code deployed to staging:
    - suggestions-service read APIs (redwood#18642)
    - savings estimation v1 (redwood#18657) + double-counting fix (redwood#18710)
    - risk scoring stub present (redwood#18661) with stable risk_level values
    - Console BFF integration + gating (redwood#18674)
    - UI list + detail drawer (redwood#18680, redwood#18681)
    - analytics events (redwood#18690)
    - audit log entries + RBAC check (redwood#18695)
    - dashboards/alerts + runbook links (redwood#18702)

[ ] Data contract versioning verified:
    - savings_estimate.schema_version present in payloads (ENG-2410)
    - UI renders unknown/new fields safely (no hard failures)
    - contract includes “basis of estimate” fields and clearly marks missing telemetry

[ ] RBAC permissions validated (staging):
    - Only roles with permission “console.optimize.suggestions.read” can view
    - Behavior for unauthorized users:
      - No nav item
      - Direct URL returns 403 + friendly message (no data leakage)

[ ] Tenant isolation test:
    - Confirm workspace_id scoping enforced at ALL layers:
      - BFF request -> suggestions-service request includes workspace_id
      - suggestions-service queries are scoped and validated
      - caching keys include workspace_id (no cross-tenant cache bleed)
    - Run “canary negative test”: login as workspace A, attempt to access suggestion_id known from workspace B
      - expected: 404 (or 403) with no metadata leakage

[ ] Telemetry freshness requirements (staging):
    - Baseline cost metrics computed successfully for at least 2 internal test tenants
    - “Insufficient telemetry” state appears only when criteria not met
    - Freshness threshold configured (see “Stale estimate detection” below)

[ ] Support + CS readiness:
    - Support FAQ reviewed (Dev Patel)
    - Escalation channel and oncall routing documented
    - Known limitations included (read-only beta; estimates can change week-to-week)


Staging rollout checklist (do this first; 24–48h soak)
1) Enable service-side gates in staging
[ ] Set suggestions_service.read_api_enabled = ON (staging)
[ ] Set suggestions_beta_allowlist_enforced = ON (staging)

2) Enable BFF + UI gates in staging (internal only)
[ ] Set console.suggestions_beta_bff = ON (staging)
[ ] Set console.suggestions_beta_ui = ON (staging)

3) Add internal allowlist entries (staging)
[ ] Add 2–3 internal workspaces used by Console/Optimize teams
[ ] Verify allowlist admin tool audit trail (who/when/what)

4) Staging verification (functional)
[ ] Suggestions list loads with pagination and filters (route/model/region)
[ ] Detail drawer loads and includes:
    - What to change
    - Where it applies
    - Estimated savings (with “estimated” language)
    - Risk level chip + rationale bullets
    - Basis of estimate section (baselines window + assumptions)
[ ] Empty states:
    - no suggestions available
    - insufficient telemetry
    - service degraded (5xx) shows non-scary messaging + retry

5) Staging verification (telemetry + logging)
[ ] Analytics events appear with expected schema (no prompt/content logged)
    - suggestion_impression
    - suggestion_opened
    - suggestion_filter_applied
[ ] Audit log entries created for “Suggestions viewed” including:
    - actor
    - workspace_id
    - action (read)
    - suggestion_id (if applicable)
    - request_id
[ ] Verify logs DO NOT include raw customer prompts/responses or full token traces

6) Staging soak monitoring (24–48h)
[ ] suggestions-service p95 latency stable
[ ] Error rate stable
[ ] Stale estimate detection not firing unexpectedly
[ ] No cross-tenant access reports

Exit criteria to proceed to prod
- 0 P0/P1 bugs open related to tenant scoping, RBAC, or savings double-counting
- suggestions-service p95 < 300ms at staging load and 5xx < 0.5% over last 24h
- No stale-estimate alert > 15m sustained (see thresholds)


Production rollout checklist (beta cohort)
NOTE: Do NOT enable UI flag broadly. Cohort must be allowlisted and gated at BFF/service.

A) Pre-prod approvals (same day)
[ ] Product sign-off (Marissa + Aditya): OK to enable cohort
[ ] SRE sign-off (Rafael): dashboards/alerts in place; oncall aware
[ ] Security sign-off (Kaitlyn/Marcus): RBAC and audit logging verified in prod config
[ ] Support sign-off (Dev): FAQ ready; escalation path posted

B) Confirm prod deployments
[ ] suggestions-service build deployed to prod (commit hash recorded here: __________)
[ ] Console BFF deployed to prod (commit hash recorded here: __________)
[ ] Console UI deployed to prod (commit hash recorded here: __________)

C) Configure flags (prod)
1) Turn on service-side API gating (safe; allowlist still blocks)
[ ] suggestions_service.read_api_enabled = ON (prod)
[ ] suggestions_beta_allowlist_enforced = ON (prod)

2) Turn on BFF gate (safe; allowlist still blocks)
[ ] console.suggestions_beta_bff = ON (prod)

3) UI gate
- Option 1 (preferred): UI flag ON only for allowlisted tenants (targeted flag rules)
- Option 2: UI flag ON globally but nav item shown only when allowlisted (NOT preferred; higher risk)
[ ] console.suggestions_beta_ui = targeted allowlist only

D) Create/verify allowlist entries (prod)
[ ] Import cohort workspace_ids from Product/CS sheet (ensure workspace_id correctness)
[ ] For each entry, fill notes with owner + cohort rationale
[ ] Double-check no “similar id” mixups for large enterprise accounts (multiple workspaces)

Cohort size guidance
- Week 1: 3–5 tenants
- Week 2: expand to 10–15 if metrics and support load are stable

E) Prod verification per tenant (do immediately after enabling each tenant)
[ ] Log in as tenant admin with proper RBAC and confirm nav entry appears
[ ] Load list and open detail drawer (at least 1 suggestion)
[ ] Verify that suggestion route/model/region matches the tenant’s reality (sanity check)
[ ] Confirm “basis of estimate” timestamps are recent
[ ] Confirm audit log entry generated (spot-check in audit log viewer)
[ ] Confirm no PII/sensitive payloads in client logs/network traces

F) Monitoring + alert thresholds (prod)
Dashboards (from redwood#18702)
- suggestions-service overview: latency, RPS, error rate
- estimate freshness: percent of suggestions with stale baselines
- Console Suggestions UI: page load errors, empty-state frequency
- adoption events funnel: impression -> open -> (future) adopt

Alert thresholds (beta)
1) suggestions-service availability
- Page SRE oncall if:
  - 5xx rate > 1.0% for 10 min, OR
  - p95 latency > 750ms for 10 min, OR
  - complete outage (no successful responses) for 5 min

2) Stale estimate detection
- Warning (slack):
  - > 10% of served suggestions have baselines older than 24h for 30 min
- Page (during beta hours):
  - > 25% stale for 30 min, OR
  - any single allowlisted tenant has > 50% stale for 30 min

3) Tenant isolation / authz
- Page security + SRE immediately if:
  - any cross-tenant access bug is suspected (even if unconfirmed)
  - any audit log indicates unexpected workspace_id mismatch

4) Support signals (qualitative)
- If 2+ customers report “savings estimate changed drastically” in a week:
  - route to Product + Telemetry (Logan) for investigation
  - check baseline window changes and metering pipeline freshness

G) Communications checklist
Internal
[ ] Post in #eng-releases: rollout start time, cohort list count (not names if sensitive), rollback plan
[ ] Post in #support: what customers will see + troubleshooting + escalation template
[ ] Post in #announcements (optional): beta is live for cohort; link to docs

Customer-facing (CSM-led)
[ ] Send enablement note to each cohort tenant:
  - “read-only beta” reminder
  - where to find Suggestions in Console
  - what telemetry is required
  - how to provide feedback (form / email / Slack connect)


Rollback plan (must be ready before enabling first prod tenant)
Fast rollback (minutes)
[ ] Disable console.suggestions_beta_ui targeted rules (removes nav/page)
[ ] Disable console.suggestions_beta_bff (blocks BFF access)

Service-side containment (if needed)
[ ] Keep allowlist enforced; remove all allowlist entries (hard stop)
[ ] Disable suggestions_service.read_api_enabled (if service is unhealthy)

Data integrity
- No destructive migrations expected for read-only beta.
- If we ship schema changes that break UI, pin schema_version rendering and/or back out the deploy.


Post-rollout tracking (first 7 days)
Daily checks (Platform + SRE)
[ ] suggestions-service p95, 5xx, saturation
[ ] stale baseline % and top offenders
[ ] top UI errors (JS errors, BFF errors)
[ ] support tickets tagged “Suggestions beta”

Weekly checks (Product + Eng)
[ ] adoption funnel + “trust” proxy metrics (detail opens, time on drawer, repeat visits)
[ ] estimated vs realized savings methodology review (if we have realized signals; otherwise track deltas vs baselines)
[ ] top confusion themes from Support/CS


Open questions (track here; update as we learn)
- Should we hide savings entirely when baselines are >24h old, or show with a stronger disclaimer?
- Should we expose “confidence” separate from “risk” (user feedback is mixed)?
- What is the acceptable false-positive rate for “High risk” labeling before customers disengage?

Changelog
- 2026-02-12: initial draft (Ethan)
- 2026-02-18: added stale estimate thresholds + comms steps (Ethan/Rafael)
- 2026-02-20: tightened RBAC/audit requirements and staged soak exit criteria (Ethan/Kaitlyn/Connor)
